versions.content: Upstream requirements: SRS_Rte_00078 In case of Inter-ECU communication where receiving software components request- ing different values for the attribute handleInvalid and this attribute is set to keep for a particular R-Port, in case of reception of a data element invalid, the RTE shall raise a DataReceiveErrorEvent .
